mechanism: Gemfibrozil may increase amikacin serum concentrations and nephrotoxicity risk through renal impairment and reduced glomerular filtration, while amikacin's aminoglycoside-induced renal dysfunction can impair gemfibrozil clearance.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN, eGFR) regularly; consider alternative fibrate or antibiotic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and appropriate amikacin dosing adjustments based on renal function.
